title: Preferences get an API
summary:
User preferences gained an API, PixPal joined the catalog, and ads and image-cache behavior got some careful repairs.

Authenticated users can now read and update preferences through GET and POST `/preferences`, either one key at a time or in batches. The same PR changed GPT Image access to exclude Seed-tier users and made edited-image filenames follow the response content type.

PixPal was added to the README and website catalog. The community-built assistant works with images, screenshots, 3D games, and blog posts.

Affiliate and fallback ads now carry an explicit ad label, including in streaming responses. Ad-generation instructions also account for conversation language and preserve markdown links. The PR fixed a redirect-function naming conflict and disabled image ads.

highlights.title: User preferences API
highlights.text: Read and update your preferences through authenticated GET and POST `/preferences` requests, one key or several at a time. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
